title: MicrosoftFabricConnection
description: Microsoft Fabric Warehouse and Lakehouse Connection Config

hostPort.title: Host and Port
hostPort.description: Host and port of the Microsoft Fabric SQL endpoint (e.g., your-workspace.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com:1433).

database.title: Database
database.description: Database of the data source. This is the name of your Fabric Warehouse or Lakehouse. This is optional parameter, if you would like to restrict the metadata reading to a single database. When left blank, OpenMetadata Ingestion attempts to scan all the databases.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Azure Application (client) ID for Service Principal authentication.

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Azure Directory (tenant) ID for Service Principal authentication.

authType.title: Authentication Type
authType.description: Credential the service principal uses to obtain Microsoft Entra ID access tokens for the Fabric SQL endpoint.

oneOf.title: Client Secret
oneOf.description: Authenticate the service principal with a client secret of its Microsoft Entra ID application.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Client secret value (not the secret ID) from the application's Certificates & secrets page in Microsoft Entra ID.

oneOf.title: Certificate
oneOf.description: Authenticate the service principal with an X.509 certificate registered on its Microsoft Entra ID application.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.description: PEM-encoded X.509 certificate uploaded to the application's Certificates & secrets page in Microsoft Entra ID. It may be followed by its issuing certificate chain.

privateKey.title: Private Key
privateKey.description: PEM-encoded private key of the certificate, as PKCS#8 (`BEGIN PRIVATE KEY` or `BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY`) or PKCS#1 (`BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY`). A single PEM file holding both the key and the certificate can be supplied in both fields.

privateKeyPassphrase.title: Private Key Passphrase
privateKeyPassphrase.description: Passphrase of an encrypted private key. Leave empty when the private key is not encrypted.

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: ODBC driver version in case of pyodbc connection.

ingestAllDatabases.title: Ingest All Databases
ingestAllDatabases.description: Ingest data from all databases (Warehouses and Lakehouses) in Microsoft Fabric. You can use databaseFilterPattern on top of this.

connectionArguments.title: Connection Arguments
connectionArguments.description: Additional connection arguments such as security or protocol configs that can be sent to service during connection.

schemaFilterPattern.title: Default Schema Filter Pattern
schemaFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude schemas that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

tableFilterPattern.title: Default Table Filter Pattern
tableFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude tables that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

databaseFilterPattern.title: Default Database Filter Pattern
databaseFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude databases that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

supportsDatabase.title: Supports Database
supportsDatabase.description: The source service supports the database concept in its hierarchy
